responsibility: This scheduling description models Niagara-4 with a three-slot issue structure and shared load/store resource. It defines reservations for integer, multiply/divide, load/store, control-transfer, floating-point, and several classes of VIS operations, including empirically tuned latencies for some VIS instructions, so the scheduler can reflect Niagara-4 pipeline and slot usage rather than the simpler single-issue Niagara models.
